headline: 30y stops at 5.618%, Brent $103, Nasdaq 100 futures +0.8%, CPI Oct 14
stance: Two strong auctions pulled the long end off 24-year highs this week. CPI on Oct 14 decides whether 5.60% in the 30y holds.

news.head: 30y auction: 5.618% stop, 6.8% dealer takedown
news.body: $22bn cleared at the highest 30y auction yield since Aug 2000. Bid-to-cover 2.54, above the 2.41 five-auction average.

news.head: Trump: no Iran strike before Nov 3 midterms
news.body: Brent $102.89, -1.3% (~2:30am ET), after trading above $105 Thursday. Treasury sanctioned 17 Iranian shadow-fleet tankers.

news.head: OpenAI run-rate ~$50bn vs ~$70bn reported earlier
news.body: Chip index -3.4% Thursday. A later report says OpenAI expects $70bn or more by year-end.

news.head: Physical Dated Brent $135.74 Thursday
news.body: Futures settled $104.28. That ~$31 gap is what refiners pay; diesel crack sits at its 98th 3-year percentile.

implications: Buyers showed up at 5.62% in the 30y. A hot CPI on Oct 14 would test that bid with no auction support.
Oil drove Thursday's range in the 10y: high on the Iran strike report, low after Trump's comment.

watch.head: UMich prelim, today 10:00am
watch.body: Watch 1-year inflation expectations. Wednesday's NY Fed survey already sat at a 3-year high.

watch.head: WASDE, today 12:00pm
watch.body: Corn and soybeans trade at their 96th and 90th 3-year price percentiles into the report.

watch.head: Hurricane Isaias, near the Gulf Coast tonight
watch.body: Cat 2, tracking toward Alabama or the Florida Panhandle. Over 500K b/d of Gulf crude shut in.

watch.head: CPI, Wed Oct 14, 8:30am
watch.body: First CPI since the September hike.

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: Long end led Thursday's rally: 30y -7bp, 2y -2bp. Wednesday's supply steepening reversed in one session.
Oct 28 hike odds ~18%, down from 38% a week ago. December still carries the hike.
ECB minutes Thursday: higher long yields limit the need for more tightening. BTP-Bund 109bp (~3:50am ET).
sections.positioning: COT, Sep 29: 2y specs extended long at the 100th percentile, 10 weeks running. Thursday's rally came at the long end instead.

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: Thursday's drop was narrow: over 2/3 of S&P members rose. Energy +2.9%, tech -1.8%.
S&P members above their 50-day rose to 36.6% from 33%, on an index down day.
sections.positioning: COT, Sep 29: Russell 2000 specs extended long at the 100th percentile, new this week, up 18 points.

single_name.note: Global Partners: fuel terminals. Insider buy filed Sep 21, new to our screen today. 3.7 days to cover.

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: Listed BDCs 0.84x NAV median Oct 7, from 0.86x Oct 6. Private credit keeps cheapening.
Fiscal 2026 deficit near $2tn, up 12%. Coupon supply keeps coming even when auctions clear well.
sections.positioning: COT, Sep 29: dealer HY inventory at the 92nd percentile, new this week, up 41 points. IG inventory sits there too.
